gold_sql:
SELECT p.*, elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-117.71559 34.094359)',4326)::geography, 1000)
  AND p.amenity = 'fast_food'
  AND elev.z >= 240;

WITH claremont_uni AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-117.71559 34.094359)'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
little_caesars AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.840059 35.5891)'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
buffered_area AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(claremont_uni.geom, 1000) AS geom
  FROM claremont_uni
),
raster_clip AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(
      rast, 
      ST_Transform(buffered_area.geom, 4326)::geometry
    )
  FROM buffered_area
),
elevation_values AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Value(raster_clip.rast, 1, ST_Centroid(ST_Transform(little_caesars.geom, 4326)::geometry)) AS elevation
  FROM 
    raster_clip, little_caesars
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN elevation_values.elevation >= 240 THEN 'Little Caesars, Mooresville, NC'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS matching_restaurant,
  elevation_values.elevation
FROM 
  elevation_values;
